extra_agent_drivers: The company trades at an earnings yield of 0.96%, which is fundamentally unattractive compared to the safety of our cash equivalents.
We require a predictable 10-20 year track record of durable earnings to evaluate a franchise, which this business currently lacks.
The valuation implies a massive growth trajectory that we cannot verify, moving the idea firmly into our 'too hard' pile.
Advertising revenue, which comprises 85% of the business, faces significant competitive and platform risks that make its long-term pricing power uncertain.

We have $37.3 billion in cash and equivalent alternatives that offer far more certainty than this speculative valuation [D08].
